# SportDGX

> Independent sports and fan-travel site by MainEntry LLC (Kansas City). New daily articles for US fans: where to watch, schedules, tickets, stadiums and travel. Not affiliated with any league or team.

## SportDGX Insider articles

- [Women's World Cup 2027 Tickets: How to Buy From FIFA](https://sportdgx.com/articles/womens-world-cup-2027-tickets): Women's World Cup 2027 tickets go on sale Dec 1 at FIFA.com/tickets. Sale dates, US start times, the three packages, starting prices and how to avoid scams.
- [NFL Playoff Tiebreakers Explained: How Ties Are Broken](https://sportdgx.com/articles/nfl-playoff-tiebreakers-explained): How NFL playoff tiebreakers work: division and wild-card steps in order, three-way ties, strength of victory explained, and the Chiefs-Broncos AFC West race.
- [Women's World Cup 2027 Host Cities and Stadiums Guide](https://sportdgx.com/articles/womens-world-cup-2027-host-cities): The eight host cities and stadiums of the 2027 Women's World Cup in Brazil: who hosts the opener, semifinals and final, plus travel, weather and visa tips.
- [Where to Watch the Liga MX Liguilla in the USA (Apertura 2026)](https://sportdgx.com/articles/liga-mx-liguilla-where-to-watch-usa): Where to watch the Liga MX Liguilla in the US: channels, streaming apps and dates for the Apertura 2026 quarterfinals, semifinals and final.
